record_type_quote: The aim of the present study was to ascertain the association of rs3746876 with type 2 diabetes in an independent larger Japanese sample.

targets.authors: Okamoto, K., Iwasaki, N., Nishimura, C., Doi, K., Noiri, E., Nakamura, S. et al.
targets.title: Identification of KCNJ15 as a susceptibility gene in Asian patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus.
targets.evidence_quote: In the original report by Okamoto et al.,29 the T allele of rs3746876 within KCNJ 15 was shown to be associated with increased risk of type 2 diabetes in 3268 Japanese individuals by an association mapping of SNPs in a candidate region of chromosome 21q.
targets.outcome_quote: We could not replicate the original finding for the association of rs3746876 with type 2 diabetes, although rs3746876 was significantly associated with obese type 2 diabetes in the present Japanese population.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The overall author verdict is failure to replicate; the significant association is in the opposite direction, so statistical significance does not imply success.

reasoning: Independent Japanese cohort re-tests the association reported by reference 29 (Okamoto et al., 2010). Reference 30 is subsequent functional work and is not a separate association target.
